name: IC Interface USB — USB, SPI — SOIC
description: SMD USB interface IC cluster supporting USB and SPI functions in a SOIC package family with SOIC-20W footprints.
selection_hints: Choose for SMD designs requiring USB and SPI interface integration in a SOIC package.
Confirm land pattern alignment with SOIC-20W (7.5x12.8mm, P1.27mm) footprint specifications.
Select when utilizing KiCad symbol library parts such as MCP2210x-SO.
avoid_when: The layout demands through-hole mounting or package families other than SOIC.
Protocols outside of USB and SPI are required for the interface.
Exact electrical parameters or pinouts are needed but not provided in the cluster definition.
